acceptanceCriteria: Recognizably belongs to the Demons family and preserves every identity invariant.
Reads specifically as Demon Prince, T5, rather than another family form.
Communicates the Corona-Throne Legion Sovereign (Sovereign) archetype and its battlefield duty.
Preserves coherent load-bearing anatomy, complete limbs, and believable ground contact.
Uses at least two wind construction dimensions without a palette-only or glow-only treatment.
Keeps the attack telegraph and counterplay signal visible at gameplay scale.
Frames one complete featured subject with no crop, labels, UI text, or watermark.
Output remains a candidate until independent approved-review evidence exists; it is never a runtime asset.
anatomyInvariants: A Demon sovereign seated in a physically channeled magma throne, with horns branching into a corona, a body balanced between charred hide and source-native live fire, and enormous bat wings braced to four visible hierarchy plates.

Signature mechanic: Legion Crucible: four black-iron channels cross the magma throne beneath the Prince's branching horn corona. The Tail brand produces Imps from coal cages; the Hoof brand spends a delivered token to raise a Fiend; the Plate brand promotes a Fiend inside a sentence square into a Hellknight; and the Chain brand binds surviving elites under an Archfiend. The Prince points one corona branch to a channel, and its body becomes more native fire only along that visible route. Breaking the exposed brand plate during production drains the channel, removes that rank command, and snaps off the matching horn branch. After two breaks, the Prince leaves the throne with hide and joints reasserted around surviving native fire, cycling only remaining commands; each further plate destroys one wing-span brace and shortens the phase.
battlefieldDuty: Command and promote an infernal legion from a source-native magma throne through four hierarchy brands, then tear free as a simpler winged body as destroyed throne channels strip commands and horn branches.
constructionDimensions: Wing and horn anatomy becomes a pressure instrument through vane-cut membranes, hollow horn whistles, chain sails, tail fins, and armor exhaust channels; the T1's small wings flutter a short impulse while T2–T5 route progressively larger pressure loads.
Motion exposes force direction through membrane camber, smoke streamlines, chain bowing, asymmetric hoof lift, and a still anchor at the brand, horn root, plate seal, or throne channel.
counterplay: Read the selected rank and familiar lower-form tell, interrupt its required carrier or promotion, then strike the exposed throne plate before magma returns; each broken channel permanently removes a command, corona branch, and final-phase brace. Affinity signal: Membranes and smoke align before a pressure action while the governing brand or horn root becomes still; crossing the lee or striking that anchor collapses the displacement.
forbiddenTreatments: Palette-only wind treatment without vane anatomy, pressure routing, and force direction
Glow-only wind treatment without a still center or mechanical airflow
Generic black smoke that duplicates family-native Archfiend wings without Wind construction
Tornado effects that hide horns, hooves, tail, brands, chains, or wing count
identityInvariants: A horned head, broadening shoulders, digitigrade or hooved legs, long tail, claws, and bat-like wing membranes remain legible from cat-sized pest to enthroned sovereign.
Blood red or ashen hide, char black, source-native ember orange, molten yellow, and obsidian preserve an infernal body whose internal fire is explained anatomy rather than affinity by default.
Charred hide, obsidian, blackened iron, native molten rock, smoke, and bat membrane retain distinct surfaces instead of collapsing into a generic flame silhouette.
Brands, infernal sigils, chains, spiked black armor, skull motifs, and horn arrangements communicate authored rank and command routes without implying a universal moral taxonomy.

Horn count, wing authority, and the proportion of source-native fire or obsidian increase with rank, but every form preserves visible hide, joints, brand routes, and an interruptible hierarchy anchor.
telegraph: One corona branch lowers toward a throne channel, source-native magma recedes to reveal its brand plate, the corresponding legion rank kneels or assembles, and the vast wings frame that single route.
